description: This file implements operations for a binary search tree, including search, insert, in-order traversal, and memory cleanup functions. It manages tree nodes using pointers and recursive algorithms.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_search(struct tree_node * tree,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Performs a binary search in the tree for a given key using a comparison function.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_insert(struct tree_node ** rootp,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Inserts a new node with a specified key into the binary search tree, maintaining the BST property.

methods.name: void infix_walk(struct tree_node * t,void (* action)(void * arg,void * key),void * arg)
methods.description: Traverses the tree in-order, executing a provided action callback on each node's key.

methods.name: void tree_free(struct tree_node * t)
methods.description: Recursively frees all nodes in the tree, including the associated memory.
